basics.type: Private university under the Haryana Private Universities Act, 2006 (formerly Ansal University)
basics.other: Eight schools: architecture, design, law, management, hospitality, engineering, health sciences, and planning and development

admission: Class 12 with Physics and Maths plus one more listed subject, or a 10+3 diploma with Maths
A recognised architecture aptitude test: NATA or JEE Main (Paper 2)
B.Tech CSE & AI (with Vedam School of Technology)
Class 12 (2025 or 2026) with PCM, more than 50% in PCM and overall
Design, law, management, hospitality and other programmes

scholarships.text: Merit scholarships from the second semester onwards, based on the previous semester's results, with a minimum CGPA of 7.0 and 75% attendance.

hostel.text: Separate hostels for boys and girls on campus, with AC triple sharing and attached bathrooms, on a first-come, first-served basis.

fees.text: Sushant lists course fees programme-wise; hostel and mess are charged separately. Ask us for the current fee for your course.
